Platform_Relevance: The platform operates in Nigeria and processes personal data.
Evidence_Required: Documented scope and data processing inventory

Platform_Relevance: Identity and financial data must be processed fairly lawfully transparently and securely.
Recommended_Control: Apply purpose limitation data minimisation accuracy and retention controls.
Evidence_Required: Data inventory retention schedule and privacy policy

Platform_Relevance: Identity verification fraud detection and risk assessment each require an appropriate lawful basis.
Recommended_Control: Document and justify the lawful basis for each processing purpose.

Platform_Relevance: Individuals need appropriate information about data processing and valid consent where consent is the basis.
Recommended_Control: Provide clear privacy notices and maintain consent records where applicable.

Platform_Relevance: Profiling and financial risk assessment may create high risks to individual rights and freedoms.
Recommended_Control: Conduct a DPIA before high-risk processing and address identified risks.

Platform_Relevance: Facial recognition fingerprints or other sensitive personal data may be used for identity verification.
Recommended_Control: Determine whether data is sensitive and establish an applicable condition and safeguards before processing.

Platform_Relevance: Individuals may request access correction and exercise other applicable rights.
Recommended_Control: Create procedures for receiving verifying tracking and responding to data-subject requests.
Evidence_Required: Data-subject request procedure and request log

Platform_Relevance: Automated financial assessments may have legal or similarly significant effects.
Recommended_Control: Assess applicability and provide required human intervention opportunities and mechanisms to express views and contest decisions.
Evidence_Required: Human review procedure and appeal records

Platform_Relevance: The platform stores and processes identity and financial information.
Recommended_Control: Implement encryption access controls monitoring secure development and incident response.
Evidence_Required: Security policies access logs and test reports

Platform_Relevance: Cloud hosting and external AI providers may process data outside Nigeria.
Recommended_Control: Assess transfer conditions and safeguards before international transfers.
